headline: Every week starts with an empty plan. Pantry fills it.

slots.aside: Save recipes, ask for ideas when you are stuck, and find the week's plan waiting every Monday.

notes.title: How it works
notes.text: Save the recipes you love. Ask for ideas when you are stuck. Every Monday at 8 the app plans the week and writes the shopping list.

notes.title: Your account
notes.text: Sign in with your own account and pay by card. The weekly plan arrives by email, so it is there before you shop.
